name: Warwick Davis
bio: Warwick Ashley Davis (born 3 February 1970) is an English actor, television presenter, writer, director, comedian, and producer. He played the title characters in Willow and the “Leprechaun” film series, the Ewok Wicket in “Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi,” and both Professor Filius Flitwick and Griphook in the “Harry Potter” films.
